# omada_gateway_bandwidth_control (Resource)

Manages the gateway's transmission bandwidth control.

This is a singleton per site — import it with the site name rather than creating it.

~> **Distinct from `omada_qos_bandwidth_control`.** That resource shapes traffic per WAN port under QoS; this one is the transmission-level control with a utilisation threshold. They are separate endpoints and can be configured independently.

Per-host bandwidth rules live in the same document as a separate collection and are **not** managed here; they are preserved untouched on update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Transmission-level bandwidth control on the gateway.
#
# Not the same thing as omada_qos_bandwidth_control, which shapes traffic per
# WAN port under QoS. These are separate endpoints and configure independently.
#
# Per-host rules live in the same document and are preserved, not managed here.
resource "omada_gateway_bandwidth_control" "this" {
  enable            = false
  threshold_enable  = false
  threshold_percent = 80
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether bandwidth control is active.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the primary site. Changing forces replacement.
- `threshold_enable` (Boolean) Only apply control once the utilisation threshold is exceeded.
- `threshold_percent` (Number) Utilisation threshold, as a percentage of the link rate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The site ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A singleton per site — import by site name.
terraform import omada_gateway_bandwidth_control.this Home
```
